name: Tous (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly, red above and blue below, charged with a yellow Saint Michael on the red and a white castle on the blue.
history: The flag of Tous is of proportions 2:3, party per bend, the first half blue with the castle of the arms and the second half red with the figure of the archangel Saint Michael; it was approved by resolution of 22 November 2016 and published in the DOGV. The arms had been approved by resolution of 9 December 2004, published in the DOGV of 12 January 2005.

features.role: archangel Saint Michael slaying the dragon on the red
